remarks: Highly desirable residence in Stamford's Westover neighborhood (Greenwich line).       This gorgeous single-level residence boasts an open floor plan, which enhances the flow & spaciousness of the living areas.    A highlight of the home is the stunning custom kitchen featuring quartz counters, a large island, stainless steel appliances, and new cabinets.     An oversized family room with multiple windows and high ceilings, new carpet, and a custom built fireplace offers a cozy and inviting space for relaxation and gatherings. French doors lead out to a sun-filled patio and a large landscaped yard, complete with a newer irrigation system for easy maintenance.      The living room features a second fireplace and custom built-ins, adding character and additional living space options.      Three well-appointed bedrooms provide ample accommodation.      This single family home offers amazing convenience and proximity to Greenwich, CT. It's also close to parks, beaches, restaurants, and stores, making it an attractive choice for those seeking both tranquility and accessibility.      Don't delay - Schedule your tour today!
